title: rosa canina var. didoensis
intro: Rosa canina var. didoensis, commonly known as the dwarf wild rose, is a deciduous shrub belonging to the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its potential to support immune function, reduce inflammation, and alleviate digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. didoensis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile compounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids like kaempferol and quercetin, contribute to its potential therapeutic effects.
